svg.title: Traceweave separates candidate similarity from cryptographic provenance
svg.desc: Two side-by-side tracks. Track A is Candidate Similarity (non-authoritative): deterministic profile extraction, local catalogue comparison, byte-span localization, and proposed embedded-mark research. Track B is Offline-First Cryptographic Registration (draft-5): DSSE/in-toto statements, tw1- references, salted private catalogue commitments, verifier-local trust policy, and optional time evidence. A bottom boundary bar clarifies that neither track proves ownership, infringement, or model training.
